house party protocol.instructions: Set system volume to 70%, start some music (resume the media player, or open the music app this computer has and shuffle), and announce that the House Party Protocol is active.

clean slate protocol.instructions: Quit every open application except the file manager (Finder / File Explorer), the terminal running JARVIS and the browser showing the JARVIS interface. List the apps first and get confirmation before quitting anything with unsaved work.

workshop protocol.instructions: Prepare a coding session: open Visual Studio Code (or the platform's own IDE if VS Code is missing), a terminal, and the browser. Turn on Do Not Disturb if possible. Report system diagnostics briefly.

lockdown protocol.instructions: Mute the volume, pause any media, and lock the screen (system_control lock_screen). Speak a one-line farewell first.

morning briefing.instructions: Give a crisp morning briefing: greeting, the time and date, local weather (use the weather tool), battery and system status, top 3 news headlines from a web search, and today's calendar events if a calendar tool is available. Show the key facts in a HUD panel.

eyes on protocol.instructions: Look through the webcam and give a tactical-style scene assessment: people present, what they are doing, objects of note, lighting. Display it in a HUD panel titled SCAN REPORT.
